stage_info.name: particle_picking
stage_info.description: Particle picking stage: Detect and extract particles from micrographs using blob picker

input.micrograph_location_description: Location of the micrographs for particle picking. If null, will read from the output of the preprocessing agent. Can be a CryoSPARC job UID (e.g., 'J84') or a path to micrographs.

blob_picker.particle_diameter_description: Minimum expected particle diameter in Angstroms. This is the most critical parameter for blob detection and should match the actual size of your protein complex. Typical range: 50-500 Å.
blob_picker.diameter_max_description: Maximum particle diameter in Angstroms. If null, defaults to 2.0 × particle_diameter. Defines the upper bound of the particle size search range. Useful for particles with size variation.

particle_extraction.box_size_pix_description: Extraction box size in pixels. Calculated as 300.0/1.34 + 125 ≈ 360.
particle_extraction.extract_downscale_factor_description: Downsampling factor for extraction. 1.0 = no downsampling. Values like 2.0 or 4.0 reduce box size for initial processing and speed. Typical range: 1.0-4.0.
particle_extraction.bg_radius_description: Background normalization radius in Angstroms. If null, defaults to particle_diameter/2. Used to normalize particle images by subtracting local background.
particle_extraction.invert_contrast_description: Whether to invert image contrast. Set to true if particles appear dark on light background (most common). Set to false if particles appear bright.

2d_classification.num_classes_description: Number of 2D classes to generate. More classes provide finer particle views but require more particles. Typical range: 20-200 depending on dataset size and particle heterogeneity.
2d_classification.max_iterations_description: Maximum number of classification iterations. More iterations allow better convergence but take longer. Typical range: 15-30.
2d_classification.initial_resolution_description: Initial resolution limit in Angstroms for classification. Start with lower resolution (higher value) for better initial alignment. Typical range: 10-20 Å.
2d_classification.final_resolution_description: Final resolution limit in Angstroms. The algorithm progressively increases resolution up to this limit. Should match expected resolution of 2D classes. Typical range: 4-8 Å.
2d_classification.batch_size_per_class_description: Number of particles per class for online-EM updates. Larger values are more stable but slower. Typical range: 100-500.
2d_classification.force_max_res_description: Whether to force maximum resolution limit throughout classification. If false, resolution increases adaptively during iterations.

select_2d_classes.selection_mode_description: Strategy for selecting 2D classes: 'top_n' uses particle counts, 'cryosift' runs CryoSift scores.
select_2d_classes.top_n_classes_description: Number of top classes to select based on particle count. Used for BOTH selections (first and final) when selection_mode is 'top_n'.
select_2d_classes.cryosift_threshold_description: CryoSift confidence threshold (1-5). Classes scoring BELOW this value are selected when using selection_mode='cryosift' Usually keep as 3.
select_2d_classes.cryosift_env_description: Conda environment used to run CryoSift evaluation (passed to conda run -n <env>).
select_2d_classes.cryosift_weights_path_description: Path to the CryoSift neural network weights file.
select_2d_classes.cryosift_evaluator_script_path_descripti: Path to the CryoSift evaluator script (output_class_list.py).
select_2d_classes.cryosift_output_subdir_description: Subdirectory (relative to the CryoSPARC 2D classification job directory) where CryoSift outputs will be written.
select_2d_classes.cryosift_fallback_strategy_description: Fallback behaviour if CryoSift evaluation fails. 'top_n' falls back to particle-count selection; set to 'error' to abort instead.

template_picker.lowpass_resolution_description: Low-pass filter resolution in Angstroms for template matching. Higher values (20-30 Å) are more robust for initial picking.
template_picker.angle_search_range_description: Angular search range in degrees for template matching. 180 covers all orientations for symmetric particles.

steps.name: blob_picker
steps.description: Detect particles using GPU-accelerated Gaussian blob detection algorithm. Initial particle detection using circular feature detection.
steps.notes: Uses 'blob_picker_gpu' job type in CryoSPARC. First step in the workflow.

steps.name: particle_extraction
steps.description: Extract particle images from micrographs using particle coordinates. Uses same parameters for all extractions.
steps.notes: Uses 'extract_micrographs_gpu' job type in CryoSPARC. Executed twice in workflow (after blob picker and after template picker) with same parameters.

steps.name: 2d_classification
steps.description: Classify extracted particles into 2D class averages using online-EM algorithm. Uses same parameters for all classifications.
steps.notes: Uses 'class_2D' job type in CryoSPARC. Executed twice in workflow with same parameters.

steps.name: select_2d_classes
steps.description: Select 2D classes using either particle-count ranking (top_n) or CryoSift scores.
steps.notes: Executed twice: once to generate templates for template picker, once for final particle selection. Same parameters both times.

steps.name: template_picker
steps.description: Template-based particle picking using selected 2D class averages as templates. More accurate than blob picker.
steps.notes: Uses 'template_picker_gpu' job type in CryoSPARC. Uses selected classes from first round as templates.
